cases.translation: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law.
cases.explain: The transitive verb встретить takes a direct object; for an animate noun the accusative equals the genitive form тестя.

cases.sentence: Он расположился лагерем в ___ у Божьей горы.
cases.translation: He had encamped in the wilderness at the mountain of God.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: He had encamped by the mountain of God.
cases.explain: The preposition у governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я иду к тебе с твоей ___.
cases.translation: I am coming to you with your wife.
cases.explain: The preposition с in the sense of 'together with' governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Be a mediator for the people before God.
cases.explain: The preposition для governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Choose from the people men who fear God.
cases.explain: The verb бояться (to fear) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Господь сделал с ___ и египтянами ради Израиля.
cases.translation: The Lord had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel's sake.
cases.explain: The preposition с in the sense of 'with/to' governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: The people will disperse to their homes content.
cases.explain: The preposition по in the distributive sense governs the dative case (here plural домам).

reading.ru: Моисей вышел встретить тестя, поклонился ему и поцеловал его.
reading.question: How did Moses greet his father-in-law?
reading.explain: The text says Moses 'поклонился ему и поцеловал его' (bowed to him and kissed him).

reading.ru: Моисей рассказал тестю о том, что Господь сделал с фараоном и египтянами ради Израиля.
reading.question: What did Moses tell his father-in-law about?
options: All the Lord had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians
His plans to build an altar
The route to the Promised Land
reading.correct: All the Lord had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians
reading.explain: The text says Moses told him 'что Господь сделал с фараоном и египтянами' (what the Lord had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians).

reading.ru: Иофор, тесть Моисея, принес Богу всесожжение и другие жертвы.
reading.question: What did Jethro offer to God?
options: A burnt offering and other sacrifices
reading.correct: A burnt offering and other sacrifices
reading.explain: The text says Jethro 'принес Богу всесожжение и другие жертвы' (brought God a burnt offering and other sacrifices).

reading.ru: На следующий день Моисей принялся разбирать тяжбы народа, и народ толпился вокруг него с утра до вечера.
reading.question: What did Moses do the next day?
options: He judged the people's disputes all day
reading.correct: He judged the people's disputes all day
reading.explain: The text says Moses 'принялся разбирать тяжбы народа' from morning to evening (began to judge the people's disputes).

reading.ru: Эта работа слишком тяжела для тебя одного.
reading.question: What did Jethro say about the work Moses was doing?
options: It was too heavy for him alone
reading.correct: It was too heavy for him alone
reading.explain: The text says 'Эта работа слишком тяжела для тебя одного' (this work is too heavy for you alone).

reading.ru: Моисей послушался тестя и сделал, как тот сказал.
reading.question: How did Moses respond to his father-in-law's advice?
options: He listened and did as he said
reading.correct: He listened and did as he said
reading.explain: The text says 'Моисей послушался тестя и сделал, как тот сказал' (Moses obeyed his father-in-law and did as he said).
